contacts.job_title: General Manager of eCommerce and Marketing. ASX-listed, Multi-brand Retail Group

company.name: BCF (Boating Camping Fishing)
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Energy bars (Offgrid Drifters), breakfast bowls and freeze-dried trail meals (Back Country Cuisine, Outdoor Gourmet Company) alongside outdoor and camping equipment
company.channels_supplied: Own chain of over 160 stores nationwide and its own online shop
what_they_do_well: Runs over 160 stores nationwide as part of Super Retail Group.
company.fit_rationale: A national outdoor and sports equipment chain owned by Super Retail Group whose own online shop sells other brands' energy bars and trail food, so Diablo's muesli bars and snacks fit its food shelf. A Newcastle-area store was not confirmed in this run; it sells online and in store nationwide.

company.name: Blooms The Chemist
company.distributes: Weight management and protein bars (The Man Bar and other brands), protein shakes and sports nutrition on its pharmacy shelves and online shop.
company.channels_supplied: Over 100 pharmacies nationally, including Raymond Terrace and Green Hills in the Hunter, plus its online shop.
company.sf_brands_carried: Weight management bars and shakes such as The Man Bar, Optifast and Musashi.
what_they_do_well: Operates over 100 pharmacies nationally, with Hunter stores at Raymond Terrace and Green Hills.
company.fit_rationale: A national pharmacy chain of over 100 stores with Hunter stores at Raymond Terrace and Green Hills, whose website sells other brands' bars under weight management and sports nutrition. Diablo's no-added-sugar bars suit the health shelf of a pharmacy chain, which also brings scale beyond Newcastle. Exact Newcastle store count not shown on its store finder page.

company.name: Booty N Buff
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Protein bars, protein cookies, peanut butter cups, protein snacks and peanut butter spread from other brands (Quest, Lenny & Larry's, EQ Food, Legendary Foods, Body Science, ATP Science, Macro Mike)
company.channels_supplied: Its own sports nutrition shop in Caringbah, Sydney and its online shop for Australian shoppers; delivery area not stated on the pages checked
company.sf_brands_carried: Low sugar and high protein snacks: Quest, Legendary Foods, Body Science low carb bars, Lenny & Larry's
what_they_do_well: Runs a dedicated snacks collection of 31 products across brands such as Quest, Legendary Foods and Lenny & Larry's.
company.fit_rationale: A sports nutrition shop whose snacks section lists 31 products from other brands, including protein cookies, bars and peanut butter cups, sold to health-conscious shoppers online. Diablo's sugar-free chocolate, cookies and spreads sit alongside the low sugar protein snacks it already sells.

company.name: City Health Australia
company.distributes: Protein bars and cookies (Fibre Boost, Maxine's, Max's, CMBT, Blue Dinosaur, Macro Mike), snacks and chocolate in its health food section, plus sports nutrition and vitamins.
company.channels_supplied: Its health food and sports nutrition shop at 146 Hunter Street, Newcastle, and its online shop shipping Australia wide.
company.sf_brands_carried: Better-for-you protein bars and cookies such as Fibre Boost and Maxine's Burn Cookie.
what_they_do_well: Combines a Newcastle CBD shop on Hunter Street with an online store offering fast shipping Australia wide.
company.fit_rationale: A family owned Newcastle health food and sports nutrition retailer whose website has a protein bars category with other brands' bars and cookies and a food section with snacks and chocolate. Its shoppers are the health-conscious buyers Diablo targets, and the online shop extends reach beyond the Hunter Street store. Store count beyond the Newcastle shop not stated on its website.

company.name: Gift Basket Boutique
company.distributes: Gift hampers with chocolate (Lindt, Cadbury), shortbread biscuits, popcorn and savoury snacks, plus pamper and baby hampers
company.channels_supplied: Corporate and private customers Australia-wide, with a Canberra page, free standard delivery and express next business day delivery to Canberra
company.sf_brands_carried: Organic and green living hampers; no sugar free brand named
what_they_do_well: Delivering gift hampers Australia-wide since 2010 and serving Canberra for over ten years.
Gives each customer a dedicated sales coordinator for custom hampers.
company.fit_rationale: A national hamper company that has served Canberra for over ten years and builds its baskets from branded chocolate such as Lindt and Cadbury plus biscuits and snacks. Diablo's chocolate boxes, biscuits and gift packs fit its sweet and get well hampers, and a sugar free hamper is a natural addition for corporate buyers. Storage: makes up hampers to order from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Gift Box Gallery
company.distributes: Gift boxes and hampers with branded chocolate (Whittaker's, Chocolatier, Choca Mama, Ferrero), cookies and fudge (Byron Bay), sweets (Ogilvie & Co humbugs, rocky road) and snacks (Sweet Az popcorn)
company.channels_supplied: Online shop with Australia-wide delivery; corporate client gifts, staff rewards and real estate settlement gifts
what_they_do_well: A second-generation Gold Coast business creating premium gift hampers since 1998.
Runs a corporate programme with logo-branded cards and volume discounts for orders of ten or more.
company.fit_rationale: Gold Coast hamper company with a strong corporate gifting business whose product pages list several other brands' chocolate, cookies, sweets and snacks. Its Gourmet Snacker and Sweet Moments boxes are built around exactly the categories Diablo sells. Storage: sells from its own stock, assembled at its studio in Nerang.

company.name: Gold Coast Vending Machines (GCVM)
company.distributes: Snacks, protein bars and gluten-free snacks, plus drinks, protein shakes and juices through vending machines
company.channels_supplied: Vending machines in offices, hospitals, showrooms, warehouses, TAFEs, accommodation venues and building sites across the Gold Coast and Northern NSW
company.sf_brands_carried: Protein bars and gluten-free options; brands not named on its website
what_they_do_well: Independently owned and operated Gold Coast vending business founded in 2008.
Services sites weekly and restocks larger sites daily, seven days a week.
company.fit_rationale: An independent Gold Coast operator since 2008 that stocks snacks and protein bars for health-conscious workplaces, hospitals and TAFEs. It ranks below tier 1 because its website names no snack brands. Storage: restocks its own machines weekly or daily from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Gourmet by Design
company.distributes: Gift hampers with biscuits and cookies (Charlie's, Butterfingers), chocolate, chocolate coated nuts (Nutworks) and sweet selections; 131 hampers plus build your own
company.channels_supplied: Corporate clients and shoppers in Canberra and Queanbeyan with same day delivery, Australia-wide shipping and click and collect at Hume
company.sf_brands_carried: Gluten free, vegan and dairy free hamper filters; no sugar free brand named
what_they_do_well: Gifting in Canberra since 2004, with same day delivery across Canberra and Queanbeyan.
Handles large corporate orders through a dedicated corporate hampers page.
company.fit_rationale: A Canberra hamper house since 2004 that buys in branded biscuits and chocolate snacks from other makers, such as Charlie's and Butterfingers, and packs them into corporate and private hampers. Diablo's biscuits, chocolate and gift boxes would suit its sweet, gluten free and vegan hamper lines. It also packs some chocolate bark under its own name. Storage: sells from its own stock at its Hume premises, warehouse size not named on its website.

company.name: Organic Feast Wholefoods Market
company.distributes: Chocolate (Tony's Chocolonely, Alter Eco, Loco Love, Organic Times), sweets and chewing gum (PUR Gum), sweet biscuits (Koja, Fine Fettle), bars (Blue Dinosaur, Tropeaka, The Carob Kitchen), chocolate coated snacks and spreads.
company.channels_supplied: Its wholefoods market in East Maitland and its online shop with home delivery across Newcastle, Lake Macquarie, Port Stephens, Maitland, Cessnock and the Upper Hunter.
company.sf_brands_carried: Naturally sweetened and better-for-you brands such as The Carob Kitchen and Loco Love; no stevia sugar-free confectionery seen.
what_they_do_well: Delivers groceries across Newcastle, Lake Macquarie, Port Stephens, Maitland and the Upper Hunter from its online shop.
Its chocolates section alone lists 92 products from brands such as Loco Love, Alter Eco and Tony's Chocolonely.
company.fit_rationale: A certified organic, family owned wholefoods market whose online shop has separate chocolates, sweets, sweet biscuits, bars and choc coated sections stocked with other companies' brands, including European chocolate such as Tony's Chocolonely. It delivers across Greater Newcastle and the Hunter, so Diablo's vegan bars, wafers and spreads would reach health-conscious shoppers there. Single store; store count beyond East Maitland not stated.

company.name: RunDNA (formerly Sportitude)
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Energy bars, protein bars, energy chews and gels from other brands (Clif, Winners, Shotz, Max's, Maurten, Koda, PURE)
company.channels_supplied: Its online running shop for Australian shoppers (sportitude.com.au now redirects to it); head office not stated on its website
company.sf_brands_carried: Max's Hydroxy Phase+ Cut Carbs high protein bars
what_they_do_well: Built a dedicated sports nutrition range of bars, chews, gels and hydration from brands such as Clif, Maurten and Winners.
company.fit_rationale: An online running and sports shop with its own Energy Bars and Snacks category of other brands' bars and chews, sold to runners and other health-conscious shoppers across Australia. Diablo's muesli and cereal bars and gummies fit the bars and chews it already stocks.

company.name: The Sweet Owl Hampers
company.distributes: Confectionery and chocolate hampers with Darrell Lea liquorice and chocolate, Oreo chocolate coated cookies, jubes, nougat, pretzels and nuts; over 100 hampers
company.channels_supplied: Corporate gift hampers and bulk orders, shoppers Australia-wide with a Canberra collection, a wholesale account option and a Ballarat chocolate store
what_they_do_well: Offers over 100 gift hampers delivered Australia-wide, including a Canberra collection.
Donates to the On Track Foundation's Soup Bus.
company.fit_rationale: A sweets-led hamper company whose hampers are built from branded confectionery and biscuits such as Darrell Lea and Oreo, handpicked from outside suppliers, with corporate and bulk ordering. Diablo's chocolate, gummies and biscuits match its range directly and would give it a sugar free hamper. Storage: ships hampers from its own stock and runs a chocolate store in Ballarat, warehouse not named on its website.
